tei:div.tei:p: 249) yum chen mau'i dbang bskur mdor bsdus bzhugs/

na mo gu ru bhyaḥ gang du bya bar tshom bu bkod pa'i gzhir/ sku rten/ bum pa bcud ldan/ rdzas tsaka rnams la/ mchod pa rnams lnga/ 'das gtor/ cha gsum gtor ma rnams kyang bsdog rang gi mdun du rdor dril/ spos snod/ 'thor nas sogs 'du bya/ khrus dang phyag sngon du 'gro bas/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs dang*/ tshad med bzhi sgom pa rnams lan gsum gsum dang*/ byang chub sems khyad par can bsgom/ thams cad du yang sa gzhi dag gseg ma dal sogs med pa dang*// lag mthil ltar mnyams bai ḍūrya'i// rang bzhin 'jam por gnas gyur cig pho brang yid 'ong nyams dga' bar// gdan khri mdzes shing blta na sdug /ngo mtshar mchod sprin rgya mtsho yis// rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar gyur/ mchod sprin gzungs lan gsum/ chos nyid dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med kyang*// gzhi dang lam dang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen// bdag med stong pa don dam yang dag mtha'// yum chen pha rol phyin ma gshegs su gsol// oṃ e hya hi bha ga 250) wā'an ma hā kā ru ṇi ka dṛ shya hoḥ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ spyan drangs pas gdan la bzhugs pa ni/ yum chen mo gser mdog phyag dang po gnyis mnyam bzhag 'og ma gnyis chos 'chad glegs bam 'dzin pa la/ ston pa shākya thub pa/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas/ spyan ras gzigs/ phyag na rdo rje/ shā ri'i bu sogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mtha' yas pa'am 'khor gyis bskor ba'o/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gā gā na sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ gis mchod yon dbul/ padma ā sa na tiṣtha sa ma st+waṃ/ gyis bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ sarba de ba ta artsi ta a mṛ ta swa hā/ khrus gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ne swa hā sa sku phyi/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra ba sa se pra tītstsha swa hā/ sa gos nyung 'bul/ ji snyed su dag= sogs kyis yan lag bdun pa 'bul/ sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par shog /sems can thams cad bde zhing skyid par shog

/nyin dang mtshan du chos la spyod par shog /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub par shog ces pas gsol ba gdab/ sku las 'od 'phros 'phags 251) mchod ngan song sbyangs// bdag la phog pas byin rlabs mthu nus thob// gzungs chab la khyab dag byed bdud rtsir gyur// ting 'dzin sgo brgyar 'jug pa'i skal ldan gyur/ oṃ dhī pradzñā ma hā pradzñā dharmā dhā tu swa hā/ zhes dang ga te ci rigs bzla/ thun mthar/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ dhuppe puṣpe ā lo ke ghandhe nai wi dya shabda pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ gis mchod/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas gtor ma 'bul/ sku'i 'od zer bum chu la khyab pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ 'dir cha gsum gtang*/ bdag 'jug ni/ gtsug gi nor bu'i 'od kyi rgyal ba mchod// byin rlabs spyi bor thim pas rjes gnang thob// dkyil 'khor lha las rang 'dra'i sku chad de// spyi bor thim pas sgrib byang dbang thob bsam/ de nas slob ma la khrus bya/ bgegs gtor btang la mtshams bcad/ sems bskyed dang chos nyan pa'i kun spyod dang mtshams sbyor ci rigs pa las/ 'dir skabs su bab pa lung a nu yo ga 'dus pa chen po mdo rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du chu bo bzhi rdzogs 252) kyi dbang sum cu rtsa drug la/ yan lag rags pa brgyad brgya so gcig tu phye nas bskur ba la'ang*/ sa dang po 'gyur ba ma nges pa nas/ sa bcu pa rdzogs pa cig chub kyi bar non par bya ba'i don du/ lha mi'i dbang nas brtsams te/ a nu rang lugs kyi rdzogs rim mthar thug a ti'i bar du byung zhing*/ lam steg gyi theg pa rnams so so'i lam dang tshul 'dra rung du byung yang*/ don la 'bras bu'i theg pa'i thabs mkhas kyis zin pas/ theg pa rang rang gi spang thob dang rigs 'dra'i yon tan de dang*/ de skye ba'i myur lam du 'gyur ba'i phyi dbang rgyud kyi chu bo'i yan lag gi dkyil 'khor bzhi pa byang sems theg pa'i dkyil 'khor la/

ston pa gtso bor byas pa dang*/ yum chen mo gtso bor byas pa gnyis kyi phyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba la= sogs/ sbrel la maṇḍal 'bul/ yan lag bdun pas tshogs bsog pa'i phyir/ phyag 'tshal ba dang= sogs dang*/ sems bskyed pa dang*/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs= lan gsum/ gsol ba gdab pa/ slob dpon sangs rgyas dgongs su gsol// bden gnyis don rtogs theg chen gyi// rgyal ba'i mdzad pa mthar phyin pa/ 253) /zab cing rgya che'i dbang rnams stsol/ zhes lan gsum/ thog mar lha dbang bskur ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi rnam par byon nas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas thim pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ sgrib gnyis byang zhing*/ bdag skyed gnyis rtogs kyi yon tan rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes khyad par can rgyud la skyes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐/ dbus phyogs padma zla rgyas steng*// yum chen rgyan ldan rdo rje'i skyil// gser mdog sku ni shin tu rgyas// phyag bzhi dang po mnyam bzhag can// 'og gnyis chos 'chad puusti 'dzin// 'gro ba sems can don mdzad pa// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas bskor// de yi dbang mchog thob par shog oṃ dhī pradzñā ma hā pradzñā dharmā dhā tu swa hā/ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ rdzas dbang la/ sngon byung ston pa'i rnam thar dang*// rjes mthun yon tan khyad par can /skyed byed dbu rgyan yum gyi phyag /seng phrug glang phrug ka shi'i ras// rgyal po'i bka' rtags dbang thob shog bum pa la 254) klu rgyal bdud rtsi'i chu blangs te// bcom ldan drin lan gsab pa'i phyir// sku yi dri ma yongs su bkru// skyon gyi dri ma dag par shog rdzas gzhan rnams ni/ ming dang rgyan cha yig shing dang*// mda' gzhu btsun mo shing rta bc-ibs// shan gri gseg par na bza' dang*// 'o thug 'bras chan bu ram sbrang// byang sems mdzad pa nyi shu'i rdzas// 'gro 'dul mtshan nyid dbang thob shog

/de ltar byang sems theg pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po yum chen mo'i dbang bskur bas/ mdo rang lugs kyi sbyor lam gnyis pa mtshan ma rtags kyi rnal 'byor bslab pa rgyun gyi sa non pa dang rigs 'dra ba'i yon tan gsos thebs/ mngon du rgyu yi bag chags 'bring po dag srid zhi las rnam par grol ba'i rgyu dang*/ lam gong ma la sbyor ba'i sbyor ba byang chub kyi sems skye ba'i stegs su gyur/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyal tshab chen po sa bcu pa'i byang sems kyi rtogs rigs dang 'dra ba'i yon tan khyad par can thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ dam tshig khas len/ gtang rag maṇḍal/ 255) lus 'bul bas/ dge ba bsngo zhing slob ma gyes/ slob dpon gyis rjes chog mchod bstod/ nongs bshags/ rten bzhugs/ bsngo smon bkra shis spyi ltar bya'o/ zhes pa'ang rang gzhan la spar kha'i bcos rim sogs la nye bar mkho bas 'dus pa mdo'i yan lag gi dkyil 'khor las phyung te shin tu mdor bsdus pa'i tshul du dpal chen 'dus pa rtsal des bsdebs pa dge legs 'phel// zhus so// 256)
